description: This file defines the 'SerialPortEvent' class, which models serial port events in the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library. It includes constants for different event types, properties for event details, and methods for retrieving event information and checking event types.

classes.name: SerialPortEvent
classes.description: Represents serial port events such as data received, control line status changes, and error states within the jSSC library.

methods.name: SerialPortEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing event with port name, event type, and event value.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port associated with this event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getEventValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the event, which varies depending on the event type.

methods.name: isRXCHAR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXCHAR (data received).

methods.name: isRXFLAG
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXFLAG.

methods.name: isTXEMPTY
methods.description: Checks if the event type is TXEMPTY (transmit buffer empty).

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks if the event type is CTS (Clear To Send).

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is DSR (Data Set Ready).

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RLSD (Receive Line Signal Detect).

methods.name: isBREAK
methods.description: Checks if the event type is BREAK.

methods.name: isERR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is ERR (error).

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RING (ring indicator).
